{{Quote|He arrives. But who is that with him? I recognize the sector governor, but not the lean and hungry-looking one beside him.''"<br />"''Lieutenant Governor Tarkin.|Orn Free Ta and Palpatine|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''individual''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the [[Moff/Legends|Sector Governor]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]<ref name="CoD" /> by [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> When the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] was held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], the sector governor and [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|Lieutenant governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] accompanied [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] to [[Seswenna Hall/Legends|Seswenna Hall]], where the summit was held. <ref name="CoD" />
